root_cause.text: In the `scs_check_usage` function, the end boundary of the shadow call stack was incorrectly computed by passing a `struct task_struct *` instead of the actual shadow call stack pointer to `__scs_magic`, causing the loop to scan an unintended memory range.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff changes `__scs_magic(tsk)` to `__scs_magic(task_scs(tsk))`. The CVE description explicitly states that `__scs_magic()` needs a `void *` (the start of the shadow call stack) but was given a `struct task_struct *`, leading to incorrect memory range scanning and potential crashes.
